## Project 1: Stats 140XP

- Conducted exploratory data analysis (EDA) on LAPD traffic collision data to identify patterns and trends.

- Developed research questions based on insights from the EDA.

- Applied statistical models, using R, to analyze data and draw meaningful conclusions

- Compiled and presented results in a comprehensive report, relating findings to external
sources.
